content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the local currency collapsed and banks froze accounts, digital creators turned to infrastructure solutions like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-guide-2|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need|Payment Solutions]]s to circumvent payment restrictions and bring their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-working-today|crypto]] stores to life. Meanwhile, Stripe's dominance in online payments has left many digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya without access to reliable payment processing. This guide will show you how to build a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages without relying on Stripe or any other restricted payment platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments are free to use, eliminating the need for expensive payment processing fees and providing a stable foundation for your digital store. By leveraging these infrastructure solutions, you can build a crypto store that's not beholden to any single platform or payment processor, giving you the freedom to adapt to changing market conditions and regulations. With this approach, you own the entire infrastructure stack, from hosting to payment processing, ensuring data sovereignty and security.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to gather the following components: the Sovereign Blueprint, NOWPayments account, and a Cloudflare Pages account. You can obtain the Sovereign Blueprint by purchasing the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), which includes the necessary documentation and source code for Stack 01. Stack 01 is deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint and provides a basic setup for your crypto store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure NOWPayments to process crypto transactions and integrate it with Cloudflare Pages. You'll also need to set up a storage solution, such as Supabase, to manage your product inventory and orders. This will involve creating a database schema, setting up API keys, and configuring webhooks to automate the payment and delivery process.
With Cloudflare Pages, you can build a crypto store that's truly sovereign and independent, free from the restrictions of major payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages and go live. This will involve configuring your domain, setting up SSL certificates, and verifying your payment processor. With your store live, you can start processing transactions and receiving payments from customers. Remember to test your payment processor thoroughly to ensure smooth operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question on every digital creator's mind is: can I build a crypto store that accepts payments without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms? The answer is yes, and it's easier than you think. By leveraging infrastructure solutions like Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, you can build a crypto store that's truly sovereign and independent, free from the restrictions of major payment platforms.
By leveraging infrastructure solutions like NOWPayments and Supabase, you can create a scalable and secure payment and delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to take your crypto store to the next level, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes a more comprehensive setup for larger digital stores. You can also check out the Edge Commerce Stack's documentation and deployment process on our GitHub page: https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Additionally, if you're interested in exploring other infrastructure solutions for your crypto store, be sure to check out our latest blog posts and tutorials.
Your Deployment Checklist

To get your crypto store up and running on Cloudflare Pages, follow these concrete steps: Deploy Stack 01 using the Sovereign Blueprint; Configure NOWPayments to process crypto transactions; Set up a storage solution, such as Supabase, to manage your product inventory and orders; Deploy your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages; Configure your domain, set up SSL certificates, and verify your payment processor; Test your payment processor thoroughly to ensure smooth operations; Monitor your infrastructure and make adjustments as needed to ensure scalability and security.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages?

To integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to configure API keys, set up webhooks, and create a payment processor integration. This will involve creating a NOWPayments account, generating API keys, and configuring your Cloudflare Pages settings to work with NOWPayments.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic setup for your crypto store, deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint. Stack 02, on the other hand, is a more comprehensive setup, deployed in 48 hours, and includes additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. If you're looking for a more robust setup, consider upgrading to Stack 02.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages can be used to host a digital product store. However, Cloudflare Pages offers more advanced features and scalability options, making it a better choice for larger digital stores.
What is the Sovereign Blueprint?

The Sovereign Blueprint is a comprehensive guide to building a crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, including documentation and source code for Stack 01. It's included in the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and provides a solid foundation for your digital store.
How do I scale my crypto store?

To scale your crypto store, you'll need to continuously monitor your infrastructure and make adjustments as needed. This may involve upgrading your Cloudflare Pages plan, increasing your storage capacity, or adding more computing power to your stack.
What is the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive setup for larger digital stores, including a more robust infrastructure stack and additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing.
What is NOWPayments?
NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment processor that allows you to accept payments from customers without relying on Stripe or other restricted payment platforms.
Can I use NOWPayments for free?
NOWPayments offers a free plan, but it comes with some limitations. You can upgrade to a paid plan for more features and scalability.
The Edge Commerce Stack offers a comprehensive setup for larger digital stores, including advanced infrastructure features and scalability options.
